name: Kota Kinabalu International Airport

runway.v: one runway, 02/20, 3,780 m x 45 m; closed every Tuesday and Wednesday 18:45-21:15 UTC (Wednesday and Thursday 02:45-05:15 local)
runway.quote: RWY 02/20 closed every Tuesday 1845-2115. RWY 02/20 closed every Wednesday 1845-2115.

hours.v: aerodrome and air traffic services open 24 hours (except the weekly runway closures)

handling.v: handling by prior arrangement with handling agents (none named); general aviation normally parks at remote Bays 16-19, Terminal 1
handling.quote: By prior arrangement with handling agents; General Aviation aircraft will normally be allocated in remote bays at Bay 16, Bay 17, Bay 18 and Bay 19 at Terminal 1.

notes: Read Malaysia eAIP AD 2 WBKK, edition effective 19 May 2026 (read in two parts, through AD 2.21). No curfew or night rule stated. AIP AMDT 03/26 (6 Aug 2026) made no WBKK change.
